Name: WSilenceW's Vintage Style Doors(CP)
Author: WSilenceW
Description:
新增八扇复古风格装饰门，可作为墙面装饰，也可以作为PIF房间的入口使用。需要CP作为前置。

这些门可以从罗宾的商店购买，或者从游戏内原有的“家具目录”中获取。

其中1-4号的门，与我已制作的哈利波特系列PIF房间mod风格一致，可以搭配着使用。

我的小红书账号：韭菜炖大鹅

=======================================================

Adds 8 new vintage style decorative doors. They can be used as wall decorations or as entrances to PIF rooms. Requires CP (Content Patcher) as a prerequisite.
These doors can be purchased from Robin's shop or obtained from the in game Furniture Catalog.

Doors 1 through 4 match the aesthetic of my existing Harry Potter themed PIF room series, making them perfect for complementary use.
